answer: Random-draw harbor gate: a new agent identity is admitted only after a verifiable random draw, published post-commit, assigns it a velvet-thin task quota across a grove of live peers. The draw seed is sealed before commitment and revealed after, so no attacker can precompute which quota slot each spawned identity will land in. Each fake identity that fails its assigned grove tasks burns the full fee with no refund, making mass spawning economically ruinous.
